title: event-waitlisting.html
content: {{snippet.EV_BlackthornAPICapacity}} You can set up a waitlist that automatically triggers when your {{variable.Object_Event}} reaches capacity, a specific {{variable.Object_EventItem}} sells out, or when a {{variable.Object_Session}} reaches capacity. Please read the documentation before using this feature. This works for paid and free {{variable.Object_Event}} s. Event Waitlisting Waitlisting can only be enabled on the {{variable.Object_Event}} OR the {{variable.Object_EventItem}} . It cannot be enabled on both. There are three fields on the {{variable.Object_Event}} object: {{variable.Field_ETEvent_WaitlistEnabled}} {{variable.Field_ETEvent_WaitlistCapacity}} {{variable.Field_ETEvent_RemainWaitlistCa}} If you created a custom permission set, users assigned to that custom permission set will need to access waitlisting. Please add Read or Edit access to the fields listed above. Enable Waitlisting Check the {{variable.Field_ETEvent_WaitlistEnabled}} field to enable waitlisting. The waitlist will become available once your {{variable.Object_Event}} reaches its {{variable.Field_ETEvent_TotalCapacity}} . At this point, the {{variable.Field_ETEvent_StatusFormula}} field on the {{variable.Object_Event}} will change to {{variable.Picklist_StatForm_SoldOuWaitOp}} . This tells your {{variable.Object_Event}} page that the normal {{variable.Object_Event}} registration is closed, but open to waitlist registrations. Waitlist Process The images below show what the registration process looks like when an {{variable.Object_Event}} has the {{variable.Field_ETEvent_WaitlistEnabled}} field checked. The Register button becomes the Join Waitlist button. All Event Items that are available will have a "Waitlist Only" label. The fields or questions included on the Attendee Form for an Event Item will be displayed when registering an Attendee for the waitlist. After defining the Attendee information, you'll see a yellow ticket next to them. This signifies the Attendee is on the waitlist. Once a potential Attendee finishes registering, an {{variable.Object_Attendee}} record with the {{variable.Field_Attendee_RegistratStatus}} of {{variable.Picklist_AttendeeReg_WaitPendi}} will be created. The {{variable.Object_Attendee}} will receive the email stored in the {{variable.Field_ETEvent_WaitlistedEmail}} field. The out-of-the-box workflow/email template is provided, but will need to be activated. Attendees won't be charged for paid registrations until they are removed from the waitlist. Activate this workflow to send out an automated waitlist email. Waitlist Sequence Salesforce tracks when an {{variable.Object_Attendee}} joins/registers for an {{variable.Object_Event}} ’s waitlist. This distinction is especially important when an Event Organizer manually creates an {{variable.Object_Attendee}} record and invites the {{variable.Object_Attendee}} to an {{variable.Object_Event}} . If the invited {{variable.Object_Attendee}} registers for the {{variable.Object_Event}} later, causing them to be added to the {{variable.Object_Event}} ’s waitlist, Salesforce will track the date and time the {{variable.Object_Attendee}} joined the waitlist. Waitlist Capacity Define the {{variable.Field_ETEvent_WaitlistCapacity}} with the number of {{variable.Object_Attendee}} s you will allow to waitlist. If you want to set an unlimited amount, simply set the field to "99999". The {{variable.Field_ETEvent_Waitlisted}} and {{variable.Field_ETEvent_RemainWaitlistCa}} fields are automatically updated based on the {{variable.Object_Attendee}} s who are waitlisted. Make sure the {{variable.Field_ETEvent_TotalCapacity}} is defined. {{variable.Object_Event}} level waitlist capacities will only be shown once waitlisting is active, not before. The number of {{variable.Object_EventItem}} s remaining will be shown when {{variable.Field_ETEvent_WaitlistEnabled}} is selected on the {{variable.Object_Event}} level and the {{variable.Field_ETEvent_RemainWaitlistCa}} is "10" or less. Once the {{variable.Field_ETEvent_RemainWaitlistCa}} = "0", then the {{variable.Object_Event}} will be marked as Sold Out. Waitlist Emails If you have activated our Waitlisted Email flow, when an Attendee's {{variable.Field_ETAttendee_RegistrStatus}} is updated to "Waitlisted - Pending," an email is immediately sent to the Attendee. Event Items and Waitlisting Enable waitlisting on the {{variable.Object_EventItem}} by checking the {{variable.Field_ETEventItem_WaitlistEnab}} field. Set the {{variable.Field_EventItem_FullName}} and {{variable.Field_EventItem_Email}} fields in the Attendee Form section to "Required". Enter the number of spots available on the waitlist in the {{variable.Field_ETEventItem_WaitCapacity}} field. If you want to set an unlimited amount, enter "99999". The {{variable.Field_ETEventItem_Waitlisted}} and {{variable.Field_ETEventItem_RemaWaitlCap}} fields are automatically updated based on the number of waitlisted {{variable.Object_Attendee}} s. Once the {{variable.Field_ETEventItem_RemaWaitlCap}} = "0", then the {{variable.Object_EventItem}} will be marked as Sold Out.   Enter an amount in the {{variable.Field_ETEventItem_QuantityAvai}} field. The {{variable.Field_ETEventItem_QuantityAvai}} field must be defined. When {{variable.Field_ETEventItem_QuantiRemain}} = "0", {{variable.Object_Attendee}} s will be waitlisted. {{variable.Field_ETEventItem_QuantiRemain}} = "0", all subsequent {{variable.Object_Attendee}} s will have a {{variable.Field_Attendee_RegistratStatus}} = {{variable.Picklist_AttendeeReg_WaitPendi}} .   Data Dictionary and Waitlist Counts {{snippet.Checkout_DataDictionaryCounts1}} Create a Data Dictionary Group {{snippet.Checkout_DataDictionaryCounts2}} Create Data Dictionary Entries {{snippet.Checkout_DataDictionaryCounts3}} Session Waitlisting Enable waitlisting on {{variable.Object_Session}} s by checking the {{variable.Field_Session_WaitlistEnabled}} field. Define the {{variable.Field_Session_WaitlistCapacity}} if there is one. If there is unlimited capacity, leave that field blank. The {{variable.Field_Session_Waitlisted}} and {{variable.Field_Session_RemainWaitlisCap}} fields are automatically updated based on the {{variable.Object_Attendee}} s who are waitlisted. Define the {{variable.Field_Session_QuantityAvailabl}} field. The {{variable.Field_Session_QuantityAvailabl}} field needs to be defined so that when the {{variable.Field_Session_QuantityRemainin}} = "0", {{variable.Object_Attendee}} s will be waitlisted. Once the {{variable.Field_Session_QuantityRemainin}} = "0", then all the subsequent {{variable.Object_Session}} {{variable.Object_Attendee}} s will have a {{variable.Field_Attendee_RegistratStatus}} = {{variable.Picklist_AttendeeReg_WaitPendi}} . Once the {{variable.Field_Session_RemainWaitlisCap}} = "0", the {{variable.Object_Session}} will be Sold Out. A waitlisted Attendee will NOT be removed automatically from a Session waitlist once a spot becomes available. If you haven’t enabled waitlist automation, your organization must define its own process to promote and notify (or use the workflow rule for email send) waitlisted Session Attendees. Automate the Waitlist Automating the waitlist means Event Organizers no longer need to manage it manually. Instead, {{variable.Object_Attendee}} s are added to the waitlist automatically. The process uses the date and time of the {{variable.Object_Attendee}} record’s creation to determine the {{variable.Object_Attendee}} ’s place in line. To activate automatic waitlisting, use the {{variable.Object_EventSettings}} ’ {{variable.Field_ETETSettings_WaitAutomat}} field. (If the {{variable.Field_ETETSettings_WaitAutomat}} field isn’t on the {{variable.Object_EventSettings}} page layout, use the steps below to add it.) To explain how waitlisting works, we’ll use an example with Attendee A and Attendee B. Set {{variable.Field_ETETSettings_WaitAutomat}} to "Yes" to turn on the automation. (The default setting is “Yes.”) Attendee A’s {{variable.Field_Attendee_RegistratStatus}} is set to "Registered." Attendee B’s {{variable.Field_Attendee_RegistratStatus}} is set to "Waitlisted – Pending." Attendee A updates their {{variable.Field_Attendee_RegistratStatus}} to “Declined” or “Canceled.” This change causes Attendee B’s {{variable.Field_Attendee_RegistratStatus}} to change to “Pending.” Attendee B will receive an email with their AttendeeLink to complete their registration. While Attendee B's {{variable.Field_Attendee_RegistratStatus}} is set to "Pending," no other {{variable.Object_Attendee}} s can register for the {{variable.Object_Event}} until Attendee B accepts or declines the invitation. At the same time, if Attendee C, who is registered for the {{variable.Object_Event}} , cancels their registration, Attendee D, who is on the waitlist, will have their {{variable.Field_Attendee_RegistratStatus}} updated to "Pending." If you want to manage the waitlist manually or if the automated waitlist sequence based on the {{variable.Object_Attendee}} record’s creation date and time does not meet your requirements, set the {{variable.Object_EventSettings}} ’ {{variable.Field_ETETSettings_WaitAutomat}} to “No.” Limitation: Attendee Groups When a primary Attendee is created or invited, and additional Attendees are added during registration, the automated waitlist may behave unexpectedly. For example, members of an Attendee Group may not receive the next available waitlist spot(s) together. Add the Waitlisting: Automate Field Click the {{variable.Button_GearIcon}} . Click {{variable.Button_Setup}} . Click the Object Manager tab. In the Quick Find box, enter and click “Event Settings”. Click the Page Layout tab. Click Event Settings Layout. Drag and drop the {{variable.Field_ETETSettings_WaitAutomat}} field on to the page layout. Click {{variable.Button_Save}} . Remove an Attendee from the Waitlist Complete the following steps to remove an {{variable.Object_Attendee}} from an {{variable.Object_Event}} or {{variable.Object_EventItem}} waitlist. Once that is done, the {{variable.Object_Attendee}} will be able to complete the registration process. Enable the workflow/email template that notifies the {{variable.Object_Attendee}} that they are off the waitlist. Update the {{variable.Object_Attendee}} 's {{variable.Field_Attendee_RegistratStatus}} to {{variable.Picklist_AttendStatus_Pending}} . This will trigger the workflow rule to send an email to the {{variable.Object_Attendee}} , inviting them to complete their registration through the AttendeeLink .  Since the {{variable.Object_Attendee}} 's {{variable.Field_Attendee_RegistratStatus}} is "Pending" and an {{variable.Object_EventItem}} was already selected, they only need to answer any custom questions and pay for the {{variable.Object_EventItem}} . ( {{variable.Object_Attendee}} s cannot add additional {{variable.Object_EventItem}} s or change their {{variable.Object_EventItem}} type.) Waitlisted {{variable.Object_Attendee}} s can also remove themselves from an {{variable.Object_Event}} 's waitlist via their AttendeeLink if the {{variable.Object_EventSettings}} ' {{variable.Field_ETETSettings_EnbCanclReg}} field is set to "Yes." What happens when a registered Attendee is deleted?  When a spot becomes available by an {{variable.Object_Attendee}} canceling their registration or an Event Organizer deleting the {{variable.Object_Attendee}} record or increasing the capacity, the waitlist automation will perform the following steps. The {{variable.Field_Attendee_RegistratStatus}} of the person at the top of the waitlist will automatically be updated to “Pending”.  A waitlist pending email will be sent to that individual. Note: The deleted {{variable.Object_Attendee}} will NOT receive an email letting them know they are no longer registered since the email can’t be tied to the {{variable.Object_Attendee}} once the {{variable.Object_Attendee}} record is deleted.
